{{Top}}
'''Skakoverbal''', also known as '''Skakoan''', was the [[Language/Legends|language]] of the [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from [[Skako/Legends|Skako]]. It was a complex form of machine code closely resembling [[Bocce/Legends|Bocce]] with elements of [[Binary/Legends|Binary]].

Skakoverbal also had a written form, called [[Skakoform]], that used graphemes similar to circuit diagrams and technical schematics.

The [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] bartender [[Klef]] could speak it.<ref name="A Reckoning of Wraiths">{{DoD|A Reckoning of Wraiths}}</ref>
